[[File:Maarten Logghe 1996 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Maarten Logghe at the 1996 World Championship.]]
'''Maarten Logghe''' was one of the twelve finalists at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]] in Vail. He won the [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]] with [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] and one Unknown teammate.

== Deck designs ==

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Logghe playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>

== Anagram ==

The [[Tatooine]] card [[Ghana Gleemort]] is an anagram of his name.<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]</ref>
